# A top-level string keeps its description, written after its default and
# constraints in the root ("default", "minLength", "pattern", then
# "description"; see json-schema-attribute-order).
input schema Name {"type": "string", "description": "A name.", "default": "none", "minLength": 1, "pattern": "^[a-z]+$"}
pipeline {"lang": "schema"}

render schema {}
